verdict.rationale: YYLO orchestrates external coding agents chosen by the user (`--subagent claude`, `yy pi`), says it can 'delegate bounded work across agents and models', and its benchmark binds 'model selectors' before execution. Together these show users pick which agent and model runs the work. The evidence never says how API keys or credentials are supplied, or whether arbitrary LLM providers or endpoints can be configured. missing for 10: documented bring-your-own API key/credential configuration, list of supported model providers or custom endpoints, per-agent model selection outside benchmarks, independent corroboration.
